# ByTomorrow Graphics

Tool for the social graphics, thumbnails and the narrowcasting screens of ByTomorrow clients
(Super Handball League, SHL Women, HandbalNL, Lotto Volley League).

## Thumbnail API (for AI and scripts)

GET /api/thumbnail?kind=<shl|shlw|nextmen|nextwomen|lvlm|lvlw>&home=<club>&away=<club>&date=YYYY-MM-DD&time=HH:MM&json=1

- The full, always current description (fields per kind, valid club codes, examples):
  GET /api/thumbnail?help=1  (JSON)  or  /api-docs  (page)
- Without json=1 the answer is the image itself, with json=1 a JSON with the URL of the image.
- Club fields take the club code or the full club name.
- Each thumbnail editor page also shows the exact API link for what is selected on that page.

## Pages

- /shl, /shlw, /handbalnl, /lvl: the client pages with the editors
- /narrowcasting: the screen, /narrowcasting/beheer: the management page (guest mode, planned meetings, agenda)
